svg.aria-label: Score matrix of a mock batch of 4 images. Rows are images; columns are the queries from each image, 4 real windows and 2 moved windows. A real query with its own image is inside (plus). A moved query with its own image is outside, same image (minus, weight 0.5). A real query with another image is mostly absent (minus, weight 0.5), sometimes outside, other image (minus, weight 0.35), or left out of the loss. A moved query with any other image is left out of the loss.
